OPEN DECISION — Frank's tone (issue #486).
Every artboard has a 'tone' tweak: 'gaffer' (full Championship Manager personality) vs 'dry' (data-first). Flip it live to compare every line of copy side by side.

OPEN DECISION — pricing.
The follow-up box on the web inbox is Pro-gated in this mockup. Flip the 'proGate' tweak on the Scout Inbox · Web artboard to preview the fully-free version. This decision shapes v1 scope — flagged to Pete before any build.

Thinnest v1 slice: the inbox list alone — price-fall + injury events from data already in packages/fpl-client (price-changes.ts, player status flags). No detail pane, no follow-ups. Deadline view and matchday feed are phase 2.

Notification channel MVP: the in-app inbox ships first (no new infra — Worker cron writes events, web reads them). Web push next, email digest via the Worker later. The two phone artboards preview the post-launch Expo app.

CM features applied to MINI LEAGUES (the growth angle): League Press is the weekly auto-written gazette — headlines, rivalry week, Manager of the Month, sack watch, league records — with one button that copies a plain-text version for the league WhatsApp group. Every other CM feature serves the individual manager; this one serves the group chat, which is where FPL actually lives. Board confidence (right column) is the CM expectations meter applied to your mini-league finish.
